question: Should I back up all 45 secret-holding places and include new ones automatically, back up selected groups, or leave them out?
big_picture: Data Backup Manager found 45 places holding sign-ins, keys or private history with no backup. This is the third request because new secret-holding places keep appearing and there is no standing rule. Backing up all 45 adds 3.1 GiB to each encrypted backup; after a restore, you may sign in again once. Choose all with a standing rule, choose groups for today only, or leave them out. If you do not answer within 7 days, nothing is added.
reason: It protects irreplaceable histories and secrets and prevents this same decision from returning whenever new places are found.
